nodes.title: Tech Bytes: Antimony — the obscure metal that could choke tech supply chains

labels.summary: The article discusses antimony, an obscure metal that could potentially disrupt technology supply chains. Nova Minerals Ltd saw significant stock price increases following developments related to this critical material.

nodes.title: The story behind the scramble for Greenland's rare earths

labels.summary: As Western nations seek to reduce dependence on China's dominance in rare earth element production, mining companies are exploring Greenland's untapped mineral deposits as a potential alternative source. The Tanbreez project represents one of the largest rare earth deposits in Greenland, though operating in the remote Arctic region presents significant challenges.

nodes.title: Critical Metals Executes Term-Sheet for 50/50 Joint Venture With EU and NATO Member, Romania, Creating a Fully Integrated Mine-to-Processing Supply Chain for Long-Term Security for the European Manufacturing & National Security Sectors

organizations: Fabrica de Prelucrare a Concentratelor de Uraniu S.R.L.

labels.summary: Critical Metals Corp announced execution of a term-sheet for a 50/50 joint venture with Romania's state-owned FPCU to develop a rare earth processing facility. The partnership aims to create the first fully integrated mine-to-processing supply chain in the Western world for critical minerals, securing long-term access for European manufacturing and defense sectors.

nodes.title: Vulcan breaks ground on German lithium, geothermal project

nodes.title: Chinese chokehold on rarest of rare earths is squeezing US defence and semiconductor industries. Here is how

labels.summary: China's export restrictions on critical rare earth elements like yttrium and scandium are creating severe supply shortages for US aerospace and semiconductor industries. The US industries' heavy reliance on Chinese mining and processing of these materials has become a significant strategic liability with no immediate solution in sight.

nodes.title: Exclusive-Rare earth shortages worsen in US aerospace, chips despite trade truce, sources say

labels.summary: US aerospace and semiconductor suppliers are facing severe shortages of rare earth elements like yttrium and scandium due to China's export restrictions, despite recent trade improvements. Yttrium prices have surged 69 times higher than a year ago, forcing some manufacturers to ration materials and pause production.

nodes.title: The New African Scramble: Contracts, Not Colonies

labels.summary: A new scramble for Africa is occurring through supply chain contracts and offtake agreements rather than military colonization, targeting critical minerals like lithium, cobalt, and platinum. While Africa dominates upstream production, it lacks midstream processing capacity, with most refining concentrated in China, creating raw export dependency.

nodes.title: Chile Unveils National Critical Minerals Strategy, Signals Broader Play Beyond Copper

labels.summary: Chile has unveiled a National Critical Minerals Strategy targeting 14 strategic materials including copper, lithium, and rare earths to position itself as a reliable global supplier for AI and clean energy technologies. The strategy aims to diversify Chile's mining sector beyond copper dependence and offer a politically stable alternative to China-dominated supply chains.
